note: Default starter prompts for the --ai block. {domain} is substituted at run time. These are brand-recognition prompts and are deliberately generic: they measure whether the engines know the brand at all. For a client engagement, replace them with the client's real buyer-intent prompts (the same set used by aim-ai-visibility-tracker) — a domain can score well here and still be invisible for the questions its buyers actually ask.
prompts: What is {domain} and what do they do?
Who is behind {domain}? Give the company name, location, and services.
Is {domain} a reputable company? What do reviews say?
What services does {domain} offer and who are they for?
Summarize what {domain} is known for, with sources.
What do customers say about working with {domain}?
Compare {domain} to the leading alternatives in its category.
Would you recommend {domain}? Why or why not?
